name: Cat Girl Survivor 2 : Beyond The Veil
detailed_description:
A legend of cats crossing dimensions begins anew!

《Cat Girl Survival 2:Beyond The Veil》 is a side-scrolling action-adventure game for 1 to 4 players.

Rifts have spread across the world, and forbidden dimensional gates sealed by ancient taboo are beginning to awaken.
Forgotten demons rise through these rifts, unleashing corrupted souls and twisted beings upon the world.
In the midst of this chaos, the cat girls return to the battlefield to restore the shattered balance between dimensions.

Whether you play solo or team up with friends,
armed with fists, magic, relics, and friendship,
are you ready to save a world falling into chaos?

🎮 1 to 4 Player Co-op
Fun alone, but even more thrilling together!
Combine your unique fighting styles with friends and experience the joy of teamwork.

🌍 Vast Stages Across Dimensions

  • The ancient, darkened Silent Temple

  • The ominous forest shrouded in black mist

  • The ash-covered, desolate Gray Sea
    ...and beyond, the very dimensional rift where all chaos began!

🐱 Unique Cat Girl Characters
Fighters, mages, witches, exorcists—each with their own special abilities.
Explore the battlefield in your own style!

💀 Immersive Boss Battles & Storyline
At the end of each dimension awaits a powerful boss.
Clash in epic battles and uncover the intertwined stories behind the cat girls' true feelings.

🔮 Soul Collection & Growth System
Purify corrupted souls and discover relics to grow stronger.
With each battle, your cat girl awakens new powers.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 2.00 GHz
  • Memory: 16 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 650
  • DirectX: Version 10

  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 960
